short_term_memory.content: Integrated technical indicators into live_trader_final.py. Created market_indicators.py module with: 1) Entry filters (volume, MACD, Bollinger, RSI, churn detection), 2) Position sizing via ATR (50% size when ATR >$5), 3) Exit triggers (BB >90%, RSI+MACD combo, support breakdown). Bot now calls get_indicators() before each trade, applies should_trade_long() filter, adjusts position size, and checks should_exit_position() on every cycle. Prevents mid-range churn (40-60% BB + low volume) that caused 13 losses today. Ready for 9am restart with smarter filtering.

Enhanced market_analysis.py with authenticated candles and advanced indicators: MACD (trend momentum), Bollinger Bands (extremes detection), ATR (volatility), EMA12/26/50 (trend). Now uses /api/v3/brokerage/market/products/ endpoint with auth. Current ETH analysis shows MACD bearish (-22.99), Bollinger 70%, ATR $4.53, low volume. Much better decision-making data than just RSI + price position.

Canceled and replaced with +2% profit targets: TAO $201.12 (was $196.76), SKR $0.01860 (was $0.01802), CRO $0.08497 (was $0.08157), ROSE $0.01708 (was $0.01666). All 9 overnight sell orders now profitable vs weighted avg buy prices from fill history. Lesson: Always verify vs actual fills, not market price.

Built market_analysis.py - real-time technical analysis using Coinbase public API. Calculates: 24h range, volatility, price position, trading signals. Analysis shows why bot struggled at 5:48 PM: ETH mid-range (50%) with high volatility (11.8%) = no edge, choppy conditions. Recommendation: Bot should be MORE SELECTIVE - avoid mid-range churn, wait for prices near 24h lows/highs for clearer edge. Now using 16-core 7950X3D for real trading intelligence.

Created 4 new cron jobs for actual execution instead of relying on heartbeat responses: 1) Trading bot management (every 5 min) - active decision-making, 2) Email check (every 30 min), 3) World events monitor (every 30 min) - earthquakes/crypto/weather, 4) Proactive work rotation (every 30 min) - GitHub/Moltbook/learning/building. This replaces the broken pattern of just replying HEARTBEAT_OK without doing work.
